title: Remedy rules of one policy version
description: The `remedies` front-matter block of a policy version (seed/tenants/*/policies/*.md), stored as policy.policy_versions.remedy_rules. Read only by the deterministic RemedyPolicyEvaluator (research R1, R2). Every row is optional; a missing row gives no remedy for that scenario and sends the remedy to manual review (FR-012).

coveredDefect.description: Remedy for a covered defect, including damage covered by the version's own accidental-damage allowance.

repairNotEconomical.description: Applies when the repair centre's estimate is strictly above the limit (FR-004).

limitPercentOfClaimValue.description: Percentage of the product's claim value (catalog.products.claim_value). An estimate equal to the limit is economical.

repairFailed.description: Applies when the number of failed repair attempts reaches afterFailedAttempts (FR-005). Below it, a new repair attempt starts.

protectionPlan.description: Whether a confirmed additional protection plan lifts the accidental-damage exclusion, and the remedy then (FR-006).

remedyList.description: Two or more allowed remedies without an order: a reviewer chooses (FR-003).

remedyChoice.description: Exactly one of `remedy` (set automatically) or `allowed` (reviewer chooses).
